ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print: «По Лао-Тсе» (Po Lao-Tse, 'after Lao-Tse') is 'After Laozi'; «Вольслей» (Vol'sley), not securely identified, is transliterated as Wolsley rather than identified as Wolsey; «Джон Рёскин» (Dzhon Ryoskin) is kept in full as John Ruskin, without a final period, as printed. In passage 7 «поучать» (pouchat', 'instruct') and «учить» (uchit', 'teach') are kept distinct.
Source observation: [23] Attribution «Джон Рёскин» lacks the final period that every other attribution has; probably a transcription slip. English mirrors it.
